557:t_015:31.en:
$$かなめ$$
「And that infuriating way of talking... I'll admit you're the real $$宗介$$.」

557:t_015:33.en:
$$かなめ$$
「But you're wasting your effort. $$ＴＡＲＴＡＲＯＳ$$ is already ready.」

557:t_015:34.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Iota wave emission will begin soon, and I'll create a new world.」

557:t_015:35.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Sure, lots of people will die, but this cruel world will soon end, and a new world...」

557:t_015:38.en:
$$宗介$$
「You keep quiet. I'm talking to $$千鳥かなめ$$.」

557:t_015:39.en:
$$かなめ$$
「What are you saying? I'm $$千鳥かなめ$$.」

557:t_015:41.en:
$$宗介$$
「You're not her. You're $$ソフィア$$.」

557:t_015:43.en:
$$かなめ$$
「She died long ago... eighteen years ago. In $$ヤムスク１１$$.」

557:t_015:45.en:
$$宗介$$
「Did you think I'd go out of my way to plead with you in a tearful voice on the battlefield?」

557:t_015:46.en:
$$宗介$$
「Too bad. I'm piloting an AS, not a $$ガンダム$$.」

557:t_015:47.en:
$$宗介$$
「Don't make me laugh. I came to get in your way and make your lives utter hell.」

557:t_015:48.en:
$$宗介$$
「While I'm at it, I'll tell everyone listening to this transmission. Listen carefully.」

557:t_015:50.en:
$$宗介$$
「Arson and destruction are my specialties. In five seconds, I'll turn that stupid occult device you worship into a pathetic pile of junk.」

557:t_015:51.en:
$$宗介$$
「Try begging pitifully. 'Please stop, this is our hope.'」

557:t_015:52.en:
$$宗介$$
「I'd love to see you cry and scream. Snivel your pathetic excuses: 'We're so hurt! Let this world disappear!'」

557:t_015:53.en:
$$宗介$$
「It'll be quite a sight. I'll record everything and broadcast your pathetic selves to the whole world!」

557:t_015:54.en:
$$宗介$$
「I'll expose you and make you laughingstocks for the next twelve thousand years! Brace yourselves!」

557:t_015:56.en:
$$かなめ$$
「All we want is a kinder, more sensitive world... That's all.」

557:t_015:57.en:
$$かなめ$$
「A world of healing, harmony, and clarity, yet vivid...」

557:t_015:60.en:
$$宗介$$
「Healing? Clarity? I'll smear it with germ-ridden shit!」

557:t_015:61.en:
$$宗介$$
「Besides, this isn't about understanding. I've decided to do it. You have to stop me with all you've got.」

557:t_015:62.en:
$$宗介$$
「This is war. Simple coercion, answered in kind... I love it!」

557:t_015:66.en:
$n
「That was splendid. You said what I wanted to say, too.」

557:t_015:67.en:
$$宗介$$
「The part about showing no consideration...? Or 'You're a horrible woman'?」

557:t_016:2.en:
$$宗介$$
「I'm all right. I twisted my body and avoided a direct hit.」

557:t_016:3.en:
$$アル$$
「However, the shoulder unit has been damaged. $$妖精の羽$$ is now unusable.」

557:t_016:4.en:
$$宗介$$
「So we'll have to fight him without it.」

557:t_017:1.en:
$n
「He still had that many $$ベヘモス$$s!?」

557:t_017:2.en:
$$レナード$$
「This is total war in the literal sense.」

557:t_017:4.en:
$$レナード$$
「I heard your little sermon. It was quite entertaining. So you knew she was $$ソフィア$$.」

557:t_017:6.en:
$$宗介$$
($$ソフィア$$ doesn't realize she's taken over $$千鳥$$. She thinks she's the real $$千鳥$$.)

557:t_017:7.en:
$$宗介$$
(If $$千鳥$$'s mind is still there somewhere, all I can do now is leave it to her.)

557:t_017:8.en:
$$宗介$$
(Those insults and taunts are the only words I can offer her. But they're the strongest words I know.)

557:t_017:9.en:
$$宗介$$
(Words that sound like me will surely reach her better than unfamiliar words of love.)

557:t_017:10.en:
$$レナード$$
「You thought that was an effective way to reach the real her... That's just like you, so single-minded.」

557:t_017:12.en:
$$宗介$$
「You seem to have special feelings for $$千鳥$$, too. But that woman isn't her. Knowing that, how can you do this so calmly?」

557:t_017:13.en:
$$レナード$$
「Everything is for the plan.」

557:t_017:14.en:
$$宗介$$
「So you're determined to reject the world as it is.」

557:t_017:15.en:
$$レナード$$
「I'm simply returning it to the way it should be.」

557:t_017:16.en:
$$宗介$$
「We're going in circles. There's no talking to you.」

557:t_017:17.en:
$$レナード$$
「In the end, we couldn't even become archenemies. We were simply in each other's way.」

557:t_017:19.en:
$$レナード$$
「Then all that's left is to settle this in battle.」

557:t_017:21.en:
$$レナード$$
「Stay out of this, $$テレサ$$.」

557:t_018:1.en:
$$ミーナ#pt251$$
「The residential block has been hit!」

557:t_018:2.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Close the bulkheads! Hurry up with firefighting!」

557:t_018:3.en:
$$宗介$$
「$$レナード$$. I'll take you on.」

557:t_018:4.en:
$$レナード$$
「Can you evade this? My $$アイザイアン・ボーン・ボウ$$?」

557:t_018:5.en:
$n
「Be careful, $$宗介$$! That bow seems to convert the $$ラムダ・ドライバ$$'s power directly into attack energy!」

557:t_018:6.en:
$$宗介$$
「So not only is it invisible, but a force field can't block it, either!」

557:t_018:7.en:
$$テッサ$$
「We've located $$カナメ$$! Ground troops, move in!」

557:t_018:9.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Be careful! $$カリーニン$$ is probably commanding the enemy infantry!」

557:t_018:11.en:
$$レナード$$
「Come on, $$相良$$! $c! I'll begin transforming the world right before your eyes!」
